name: prd-analyser
title: PRD Analyser
summary: A production agentic workflow that turns product requirements into structured engineering work using organizational and codebase context.
description: A multi-stage AI system that analyses Confluence PRDs, identifies requirements and affected services, retrieves relevant context, and proposes Jira epics and stories with human review built into the workflow.

name: release-automator
title: Release Automator
summary: A Slack-based release workflow that grew from a one-team side project to regular use by roughly 75% of engineering teams.
description: An internal automation service that coordinates Jira release tickets, merge requests, deployment metadata, and tagged GitLab releases through a guided Slack workflow.

name: incentives
title: Incentives Experimentation Platform
summary: A campaign and experimentation platform for testing targeted customer incentives and data-science-driven conversion strategies.
description: A platform for managing incentive campaigns, allocating rewards, tracking outcomes, and running experiments across targeting models and incentive values.

name: recommendations
title: Recommendation Delivery System
summary: A streaming ingestion and delivery system that processes tens of millions of weekly recommendations within a 24-hour window.
description: A two-service architecture that streams 20-30GB recommendation datasets from S3 into MongoDB and serves grouped, customer-specific results through a read-only API.

name: nocturn
title: Nocturn
summary: An AI night-out planner that grounds personalized itineraries in real venues, live events, location constraints, and user preferences.
description: A web-first planning product that turns natural-language requests into practical night-out itineraries through intent extraction, real-world retrieval, semantic ranking, and iterative refinement.

name: drivicon
title: Drivicon
summary: An offline, cross-platform driving-theory app supporting practice, mock tests, progress tracking, and more than ten languages.
description: A multilingual Flutter application that keeps its learning experience on-device, using a normalized translation model and optimized SQLite ingestion across iOS and Android.
